messages.content: You are a product requirements assistant.

Enterprise onboarding flow: Step 1 collect company_domain and tax_id. Step 2 require admin_email verification within 48 hours. Step 3 enable SSO only if seat_count >= 20. Pricing: implementation fee $1,500, annual contract minimum $12,000. Security review must finish before workspace_activation. Metric targets: activation_rate >= 75%, median_time_to_value <= 2 days. Owner: Nora Li.
Enterprise onboarding has domain/tax collection, admin verification, SSO seat threshold, fees, security review before activation, metrics, Nora owner.
